name: idle_v1
prompt: A big strong man stands relaxed in a ready stance, breathing slowly and shifting his weight slightly.

name: idle_v2
prompt: A heavy muscular warrior stands still in a wide ready stance with his arms loose at his sides, breathing.

name: walk_v1
prompt: A big strong man walks forward at a steady pace with a heavy confident stride, arms swinging naturally.

name: walk_v2
prompt: A heavy muscular warrior walks straight forward with powerful steps.

name: run_v1
prompt: A big strong man runs forward fast with heavy powerful strides, arms pumping.

name: run_v2
prompt: A heavy muscular warrior sprints straight forward, leaning into the run.

name: dash_v1
prompt: A big strong man bursts forward in a quick explosive dash of three fast steps and stops in a ready stance.

name: dash_v2
prompt: A heavy warrior lunges forward in a short fast dash, then plants his feet and stands ready.

name: slide_v1
prompt: A big strong man runs forward and drops into a feet-first sliding tackle along the ground, then gets back up.

name: slide_v2
prompt: A heavy warrior sprints and slides low on the ground feet first like a football slide tackle, then stands up.

name: leap_v1
prompt: A big strong man crouches, leaps high and far forward through the air and lands heavily with both feet, slamming the ground, then stands ready.

name: leap_v2
prompt: A heavy barbarian jumps up and forward, falls down hard and lands in a deep crouch with a heavy impact, then rises to a ready stance.

name: sword_slash_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a sword in his right hand slashes it diagonally from his right shoulder down across his body, then returns to a ready stance.

name: sword_slash_v2
prompt: A man swings a one-handed sword horizontally from right to left in front of him, then returns to a ready stance.

name: sword_thrust_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a sword in his right hand lunges forward and thrusts the sword straight ahead, then steps back to a ready stance.

name: axe_chop_v1
prompt: A warrior raises an axe in his right hand high above his head and chops it straight down in front of him, then returns to a ready stance.

name: sword_combo_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a sword in his right hand slashes left to right, then right to left, then thrusts forward, and returns to a ready stance.

name: greatsword_overhead_v1
prompt: A warrior holds a heavy greatsword with both hands, lifts it high over his head and slams it straight down in front of him, then returns to a ready stance.

name: greatsword_overhead_v2
prompt: A big man grips a huge two-handed sword, raises it behind his head and brings it down in a powerful vertical strike.

name: greatsword_sweep_v1
prompt: A warrior holds a heavy greatsword with both hands and swings it in a wide horizontal arc from his right side to his left, turning his whole body, then returns to a ready stance.

name: hammer_slam_v1
prompt: A big man raises a heavy war hammer with both hands over his shoulder and smashes it down onto the ground in front of him, then lifts it back to a ready stance.

name: parry_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a sword in his right hand raises it quickly to block a blow coming at his head, then returns to a ready stance.

name: parry_v2
prompt: A man parries an attack by sweeping his sword sideways across his body, then returns to a ready stance.

name: block_2h_v1
prompt: A warrior holds a greatsword horizontally above his head with both hands to block a heavy downward blow, then returns to a ready stance.

name: jab_v1
prompt: A boxer in a guard stance throws a quick straight left jab and brings his fist back to his guard.

name: cross_v1
prompt: A boxer in a guard stance throws a powerful straight right punch, turning his hips, and returns to his guard.

name: hook_v1
prompt: A boxer in a guard stance throws a wide left hook to the head and returns to his guard.

name: uppercut_v1
prompt: A boxer in a guard stance drops slightly and throws a rising right uppercut, then returns to his guard.

name: box_combo_v1
prompt: A boxer in a guard stance throws a left jab, a right cross and a left hook, then returns to his guard.

name: box_combo_v2
prompt: A boxer throws a fast one-two punch combination followed by a right uppercut, then returns to his guard.

name: box_guard_v1
prompt: A boxer stands in a guard stance with his fists up, bouncing lightly on his feet and moving his head.

name: front_kick_v1
prompt: A fighter in a guard stance lifts his right knee and pushes his foot straight forward in a front kick, then returns to his guard.

name: roundhouse_v1
prompt: A fighter in a guard stance pivots on his left foot and swings his right leg in a roundhouse kick at chest height, then returns to his guard.

name: knee_v1
prompt: A fighter grabs forward with both hands and drives his right knee up hard, then returns to his guard.

name: kick_combo_v1
prompt: A kickboxer throws a left jab, a right cross and a right roundhouse kick, then returns to his guard.

name: bow_shoot_b_v1
prompt: An archer raises a bow in his left hand, pulls an arrow back to his cheek with his right hand, aims and releases, then lowers the bow.
